116	// Result wraps a search result with its type and ranking metadata.
117	// Exactly one of Checkpoint, Commit, or Session is non-nil based on Type.
118	type Result struct {
119		Type       string            `json:"-"`
120		Meta       Meta              `json:"-"`
121		Checkpoint *CheckpointResult `json:"-"`
122		Commit     *CommitResult     `json:"-"`
123		Session    *SessionResult    `json:"-"`

126		rawData json.RawMessage
127	}

129	// resultJSON is the wire format for JSON marshaling/unmarshaling.
130	type resultJSON struct {

132		Data json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
133		Meta Meta            `json:"searchMeta"`
134	}

136	// MarshalJSON implements custom JSON marshaling to produce the API wire format.
137	func (r *Result) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
138		var data any
139		switch r.Type {
140		case TypeCheckpoint:
141			data = r.Checkpoint
142		case TypeCommit:
143			data = r.Commit
144		case TypeSession:
145			data = r.Session
146		default:
147			data = r.rawData
148		}
149		raw, err := json.Marshal(data)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, fmt.Errorf("marshaling result data: %w", err)
152		}
153		out, err := json.Marshal(resultJSON{
154			Type: r.Type,
155			Data: raw,
156			Meta: r.Meta,
157		})
158		if err != nil {
159			return nil, fmt.Errorf("marshaling result: %w", err)
160		}
161		return out, nil
162	}
163	
164	// UnmarshalJSON implements custom JSON unmarshaling to parse typed data.
165	func (r *Result) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
166		var raw resultJSON
167		if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
168			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshaling result: %w", err)
169		}
170		r.Type = raw.Type
171		r.Meta = raw.Meta
172		r.rawData = raw.Data
173		// Clear any previously-decoded payloads so a reused Result keeps the
174		// "exactly one typed pointer is non-nil" invariant.
175		r.Checkpoint, r.Commit, r.Session = nil, nil, nil
176	
177		switch raw.Type {
178		case TypeCheckpoint:
179			var d CheckpointResult
180			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw.Data, &d); err != nil {
181				return fmt.Errorf("unmarshaling checkpoint data: %w", err)
182			}
183			r.Checkpoint = &d
184		case TypeCommit:
185			var d CommitResult
186			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw.Data, &d); err != nil {
187				return fmt.Errorf("unmarshaling commit data: %w", err)
188			}
189			r.Commit = &d
190		case TypeSession:
191			var d SessionResult
192			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw.Data, &d); err != nil {
193				return fmt.Errorf("unmarshaling session data: %w", err)

202	func resultField(r *Result, fromCheckpoint func(*CheckpointResult) string, fromCommit func(*CommitResult) string, fromSession func(*SessionResult) string) string {

205			if r.Checkpoint != nil {

211			}

215			}

217		return ""
218	}
